brand.name: Funki Izakaya
brand.tagline: Modern Yakitoria — モダン焼き鳥屋
brand.voice: Casual, fun, izakaya-street-food energy — Tokyo alley meets QC food-park hangout

logo.note: Only 150x150 available from IG — needs Higgsfield upscale before use as site logo. Wordmark reads 'FUNKI IZAKAYA / MODERN YAKITORIA モダン焼き鳥屋' in white/red on black, brush-stroke chopstick accents.

branches.name: Funki Izakaya — Pop-Up Katipunan
branches.address: 273 Katipunan Ave, corner Xavierville Ave, Quezon City (inside The Pop-Up Katipunan food park, near Ateneo & Miriam College)
branches.hours: Estimated 9:00 AM – 2:00 AM Mon–Sat, 9:00 AM – 12:00 AM Sun (shared food-park hours)
branches.mapQuery: The Pop-Up Katipunan, 273 Katipunan Ave, Quezon City
branches.notes: Original branch, bar/grill concept — yakitori rice meals, single sticks, party platters, drink towers/buckets, full liquor menu, Funki Slink Alcoslushies.

branches.name: Funki Izakaya — Masinag
branches.address: Unit 104, Maxfill Commercial Center, Marcos Highway, Masinag, Antipolo
branches.mapQuery: Maxfill Commercial Center, Marcos Highway, Antipolo
branches.notes: Full sit-down izakaya menu — starters, domburi, yakitoridon, sushi rolls/sashimi, a la carte, ramen & noodles, platter sets, desserts.

branches.name: Funki Izakaya — Blue Ridge
branches.address: 2nd Floor, Blue Ridge A, 226 Katipunan Ave, Project 4, Quezon City (beside Arton Strip, near Kopi Roti, corner Boni Serrano/Aurora Blvd/Highland Dr)
branches.mapQuery: Blue Ridge A, 226 Katipunan Ave, Project 4, Quezon City
branches.notes: Newest branch — soft-opened Dec 14, 2025. Also available via GrabFood. Assumed same full-izakaya menu as Masinag; confirm before publishing since it's a different building/format than the Katipunan bar concept.
